purpose: Curated evidence for Suno v6 generation recipes. Official Suno sources outrank community observations. Community rules are hypotheses for controlled A/B tests, not guarantees.

sources.title: Suno Prompt Engineering Guide — style co-occurrence research
Suno Music Prompt Laboratory — iterative prompt experiments

rules.rule: Use v6 as the default production model; use v6-wild for deliberate exploration and v6-mini for fast ideation.
When exact style-tag control matters, reduce Variety to 0.
Prefer Max Mode for songs longer than two minutes and when vocal/style consistency across the full track matters.
For tighter Inspire control, use a short playlist of roughly 3-5 approved songs made by the user.
Use stronger Style Influence when preserving a channel sound is more important than exploration.
Once at least six approved tracks exist, consider a Custom Model for a recurring channel sound.
Treat style tags as a probabilistic blend. Prefer one dominant genre plus one compatible secondary color; use exclusions to resist unwanted default gravity.
Change one primary musical axis per experiment arm so the result teaches you which prompt decision mattered.
